sources: FreshQA stable true-premise questions and official SAGE, one fresh question per task/domain stratum
precommitted_policy: Paired add-one-provider ablation. No provider weight or cutoff tuning. Missing model calls are not successful default evaluations.
rrf_policy: Free supplemental fusion comparison without a relevance cutoff; explicitly not the shipped model default
source_text_policy: Identical passage selection and budgets for each arm; no provider scores or synthesized answers used
default_adoption_rule: Do not enable by default unless actual Jev+0.5-cutoff comparison completes and paired web mean evidence grade@5 improves with 95% bootstrap CI above zero, direct-answer query coverage does not decline, and operational failures remain acceptable. Otherwise retain opt-in.
web_judgment_policy: Blind assessor receives only question, reference answers, title, URL and actual displayed excerpts. Grades 0 unrelated/contradictory, 1 topical without useful evidence, 2 partial evidence, 3 directly supports the answer. Report assistant assessment separately from human or benchmark document qrels.

free_alternative.selection: Only verified live free Decisions route among the tested score/Noul models; not claimed best in quality
free_alternative.predicate: At least partial concrete evidence for the complete question, rather than topical similarity
free_alternative.limitations: Different scoring contract from Jev ordinal rubric; no numerical calibration equivalence claimed
free_alternative.rate_policy: Sequential batches with 3.1s pacing; failures recorded, no silent fallback

independent_judge.selection: Availability-only: Gemma free probe returned 504; Nemotron free probe returned valid grade and zero cost
independent_judge.input: Actual displayed web excerpts; provider/method/ranks/model scores removed; reference answers supplied for correctness only
independent_judge.scope: Independent model judgment, not human/source-verified labels; no use as retrieval ranker
independent_judge.primary_metric: Per-query mean 0-3 evidence grade among returned sources (maximum five); empty output scores zero
secondary_metrics: Direct-evidence query coverage (at least one grade 3)
